```sql
WITH ventas AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        i.producto_id,
        SUM(i.cantidad) AS unidades
    FROM pedidos p
    JOIN clientes c      ON p.cliente_id = c.cliente_id
    JOIN items i         ON i.pedido_id = p.pedido_id
    WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
      AND p.fecha BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.region, i.producto_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        producto_id,
        unidades,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY unidades DESC, producto_id) AS rn
    FROM ventas
)
SELECT 
    region,
    producto_id,
    unidades
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region;
```
